g.text: Positive drives use tooth-count ratios; smooth belts rely on effective diameter and traction

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Conceptual uncrossed belt and positive-drive layouts. Both shafts rotate in the same sense. Smooth belts can creep or slip; timing belts and chains use
engaged tooth counts for nominal ratio. Tight and slack sides reverse with transmitted torque direction; chain sag and tensioner geometry are omitted.
